breakdown.description: A horizontal traction on the vertical edge x = 0 is reinterpreted as tangential shear, even though it is normal to that edge
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the error from the incomplete prompt by explicitly treating the horizontal traction on x=0 as a shear/tangential traction T=(0,4000) Pa. The ground truth removes this reinterpretation, meaning the load should be applied as a normal (horizontal) traction on the vertical edge x=0, consistent with σ_xx=4000 Pa. The agent failed to correct this and instead perpetuated the incorrect tangential interpretation.
